_note: Shot config. Lives next to the shot hip (e.g. {shot_work}/cfx_shot.json). References an asset by name; the asset config is auto-discovered at its rules-derived path so the rest-proxy handoff links automatically.
_anim_note: The anim fbx is animation-only (skeleton); the rest skeleton + geo come from the asset caches. Duration = pre-roll/post-roll: start_duration frames simulate before frame_start so cloth settles. The 'fbx' block mirrors the studio FBX node (anim_subnet1): t_pose_start_position aligns the take's start pelvis onto the T-pose (character origin) vs keeping native; position_mult (per-axis 0..1) is root-motion retention (1=full world motion, 0=in place); t_pos + t_pos_offset_* blend the pose toward the T-pose; pelvis_rotate adds pelvis rotation. t_pose_blend ramps t_pos 1->value across the pre-roll so cloth settles from the T-pose.
